name: sdlc-skills
description: One plugin for coding agents: sdlc builds a change from criteria you write to a reviewed pull request, with hooks that decide when it is done and house rules for how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Whoever made a change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done: a story skill for the acceptance criteria you write, a spike skill for throwaway experiments, a bug skill that reproduces a fault and finds why it escaped, a refactor skill that keeps every test passing unchanged, a build skill where your acceptance criteria decide done, failing tests come first and a blind challenger holds some back, and fresh agents implement, review and verify; plus hooks for a test lock, a done check, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a holdout guard, a pull request size cap, and gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers or switch a checker off. At session start, a hook adds house rules for how the agent works with you, and a delegator agent runs non-coding tasks in parallel.
